scope: Qwen3.5-0.8B language model, RTX 4060 Laptop GPU, batch=1, 64 generated tokens, six natural prompts, BF16 weights and activations
design: C-S-S-C process order, one warmup and three measured trials per process, independent fresh compile caches for the first control and candidate runs

control.description: same vLLM source with SM89 lm_head and segmented GDN projection disabled

candidate.description: SM89 BF16 lm_head plus all-layer segmented GDN QKVZ+BA projection

strict_frontier: Keep the lm_head-only candidate: prior same-source C-S-S-C qualification is 1.1928x E2E / 1.1986x TPOT with 6/6 cross-mode exact cases.
relaxed_frontier: The combined candidate reaches 1.1904x E2E / 1.2000x TPOT versus stock in this direct C-S-S-C run, but requires a task-quality gate because GDN reduction ordering changes some greedy continuations.
